name: Vito Quijano de Pasamonte
aliases: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose
description: Vito Quijano de Pasamonte was a heretical vampire hierophant of the Church of Dusk who worshipped Aclazotz and led an expedition to Ixalan to free him.

timeline.summary: Vito, shocked by Elenda's news, overturns a carafe of blood in defiance.
timeline.quote: he overturned a massive carafe of blood onto the church's floor.

citation.work: Vito Quijano de Pasamonte
citation.text: "Vito Quijano de Pasamonte", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Back in Torrezon Elenda preaches humility and restraint, which some such as Vito refuse to heed.
timeline.quote: Elenda began preaching a message of humility and restraint

citation.work: Elenda of Garrano
citation.text: "Elenda of Garrano", section "Return". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vito Quijano de Pasamonte frees Aclazotz in Ixalan's Core and he and his followers become batlike demons.
timeline.quote: the bat god bestowed his blessing on Vito and his followers, turning them into batlike demons .

citation.work: Legion of Dusk
citation.text: "Legion of Dusk", section "The crisis of faith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Huatli summons dinosaurs and kills Vito with his own lance.
timeline.quote: Huatli summoned a horde of dinosaurs and killed Vito with his own lance.

citation.work: Legion of Dusk
citation.text: "Legion of Dusk", section "The crisis of faith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Amalia notes the expedition's goal of finding a Temple of Aclazotz and a door that may end the Church of Dusk's schism.
timeline.quote: A Temple of Aclazotz supposedly awaited them in the depths of this continent.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Vito shows the expedition Tarrian's lance and journal.
timeline.quote: was wielded by Venerable Tarrian, in whose footsteps we follow.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Vito announces the door leads to the resting place of Aclazotz and promises to return him to Torrezon.
timeline.quote: is a door that leads to the resting place of our ancient god and sire, Aclazotz, creator of the first vampires.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The expedition reaches a golden door in the catacombs, but Amalia sees it is not the door from her visions.
timeline.quote: To Amalia's surprise, this was not the door in her visions.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Bartolomé protests that Vito corrupts the blood rites, but backs down.
timeline.quote: You corrupt the sacred blood rites

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Vito sacrifices a porter on the obsidian altar.
timeline.quote: With a single swipe, Vito cut the victim's throat.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The sacrifice opens the golden door and Vito praises Aclazotz.
timeline.quote: The door groaned open.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 1" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Vito sees a mosaic of Aclazotz and reflects on Bartolomé and Amalia, whom he suspects of hearing Aclazotz's call.
timeline.quote: Was she, too, hearing Aclazotz calling to her?

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Vito resolves that he alone is Aclazotz's instrument and will bring the god to Alta Torrezon.
timeline.quote: He would prove himself worthy by bringing Aclazotz to Alta Torrezon, ending the tiresome theological debates that plagued his people.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Vito sacrifices another servant on an altar to open a second door.
timeline.quote: Clavileño and another soldier held the servant down as Vito cut his throat

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The door opens onto a vast underground desert of treacherous sand.
timeline.quote: now instead Vito faced a massive underground desert

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Clavileño flies over the desert marking solid ground and the soldiers build a makeshift plank bridge.
timeline.quote: Clavileño's legs dissolved into smoke as he rose into the air.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Mantis-spider creatures attack the column, seizing and devouring a porter and a prisoner.
timeline.quote: Their arms snapped out, snagging a porter and a prisoner, dragging them away as they screamed and flailed.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Vito orders the vampires to purge the creatures; Amalia freezes one with magic and Bartolomé beheads another with his whip.
timeline.quote: Bartolomé unfurled a whip and lashed out, wrapping it around the monster's neck.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The expedition tallies its losses on reaching the far side of the desert.
timeline.quote: They reported that beyond the two taken by the monsters, a porter, a soldier, two prisoners, and a horse had fallen into the sand.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Vito privately resolves to eliminate Bartolomé if he hinders the mission.
timeline.quote: If Bartolomé tried to hinder the mission, he would be eliminated.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Amalia and the expedition reach a cavern with a lava waterfall and a deserted-looking settlement.
timeline.quote: a thunderous fall of lava cascaded down the side of a wall, bright enough to light the entire space

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: A strange swordsman runs toward the vampires, pursued by pale goblin-like creatures.
timeline.quote: Someone emerged from a nearby building, chased by a half-dozen smaller figures.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The rescued man introduces himself as Kellan, from Eldraine.
timeline.quote: I'm Kellan

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Vito refuses to help Kellan, but Amalia takes responsibility for him and Vito grudgingly accepts.
timeline.quote: I'll take responsibility for him.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Bartolomé reveals Queen Miralda secretly assigned him to learn Vito's true intentions and loyalties.
timeline.quote: When Queen Miralda assigned Bartolomé to join this expedition, he was told to play along and discover Vito's true intentions and loyalties.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Kutzil introduces herself and demands the Legion come with her.
timeline.quote: I am Kutzil, champion of the Malamet

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Vito quietly warns Bartolomé not to undermine him again.
timeline.quote: Do not undermine me again

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The Legion is brought before Sovereign Okinec Ahau on his throne.
timeline.quote: This, presumably, was Sovereign Okinec Ahau.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Okinec Ahau rejects Vito's claim of a god and has his mythweaver Poq test their words.
timeline.quote: There are no gods here but me

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Malamet glyph magic binds the Legion in chains and forces them to kneel.
timeline.quote: The magic lashed out and wrapped around the Legion members like chains, forcing them to kneel.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The Malamet throw the Legion, one by one, into a basin of sand that drains into a hole.
timeline.quote: Bartolomé watched as the Malamet threw his comrades into the basin of sand

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: River Heralds surround and capture the Legion in the water.
timeline.quote: River Heralds, dozens, all armed with their strange jade weapons and elemental magics.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Bartolomé says Queen Miralda might negotiate, and Vito silences him until Pashona allows the work to proceed.
timeline.quote: Queen Miralda might be open to such negotiations, depending on what we find.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: When a soldier announces the Legion are vampires, Anim orders them imprisoned as worshippers of the Great Betrayer.
timeline.quote: Worshippers of the Great Betrayer are not welcome here

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Vito goes into a trance and says all proceeds according to Aclazotz's will.
timeline.quote: All proceeds according to his will

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Vito conjures a thick magical fog over the building.
timeline.quote: A magical fog covered the building, so thick her hand would disappear if she thrust it through the opening.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Clavileño tears off the door and Vito enters, bloodstained.
timeline.quote: A crimson handprint was smeared down the front of his armor

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Vito demands Kellan's blood as a sacrifice to Aclazotz.
timeline.quote: The blood of the outsider will suffice

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Bartolomé attacks Vito to block the doorway while Kellan summons his swords.
timeline.quote: Bartolomé leaped at Vito, hands curled into claws, fangs bared.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Vito breaks Bartolomé's neck and kills him.
timeline.quote: Vito locked an arm around Bartolomé's head and twisted, the terrible snap echoing in the small room.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Vito reflects that he has taken revenge on Bartolomé and leads the vampires through the fog.
timeline.quote: Despite Bartolomé thwarting his intended sacrifice, he'd finally had his revenge on that thorn of the Black Rose.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: A red-lit guide offers to lead Vito to Aclazotz.
timeline.quote: I have been sent to guide you to Aclazotz.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Vito learns that Aclazotz is a prisoner and feels doubt, then pride.
timeline.quote: Vito faltered at the mention of imprisonment.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Vito places the pink crystal key into the door, enduring pain, and the door opens.
timeline.quote: Crimson light spread to the glyphs around the door, and it rolled sideways with a deep rumbling sound.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Vito enters an amphitheater of worshippers.
timeline.quote: a thousand pale faces turned to watch Vito enter.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Vito sees Aclazotz chained with golden chains inlaid with cosmium crystals.
timeline.quote: The bat god crouched on the floor, shrouded by his wings and wrapped in loops of thick golden chains inlaid with hundreds of pink crystals.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz announces the end of the Fifth Age and demands sacrifices.
timeline.quote: The end of the Fifth Age is upon us

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The prisoners are fed to Aclazotz, and his eye brightens with each death.
timeline.quote: One by one, the prisoners were delivered unto the bat god, who feasted on their essences as Vito respectfully averted his gaze.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz bites Vito and blesses the others, transforming them into bat creatures.
timeline.quote: In a flash, he sank them deep into Vito's neck and torso.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The transformed vampires stand as bat-like monsters.
timeline.quote: Where once vampires had knelt, new creatures stood, their forms echoing their master's.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz leads the legion out and vows to imprison Chimil and end the Fifth Age.
timeline.quote: I will end the Fifth Age at last, and my children will bring the Sixth Age to the plane.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The prison's shadow darkens the Core.
timeline.quote: The shadow of that prison fell across the land, enshrouding it in a darkness deeper than any night in Torrezon.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz demands more sacrifices and Vito shrieks the order to the Legion.
timeline.quote: I require more sacrifices. You will bring them to me.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Vito impales an Oltec bat rider, who is then dragged away as a sacrifice.
timeline.quote: Vito dodged a wave of magic from an Oltec bat rider, then speared her through the midsection with his lance.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Vito engages Inti in aerial combat.
timeline.quote: This one he remembered from the introductions among the River Heralds: Inti, seneschal of the sun.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Clavileño grabs Inti while he is tethered to his falling bat.
timeline.quote: Clavileño circled behind him and gripped Inti's head in one massive claw.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Clavileño kills Inti by snapping his neck.
timeline.quote: Clavileño snapped Inti's neck and both human and bat bodies fell into darkness.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Huatli screams and dives after her fallen comrade, and Vito follows her.
timeline.quote: She, too, would make an excellent sacrifice.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Transformed Vito arrives to capture Huatli for Aclazotz.
timeline.quote: Aclazotz will be pleased when I deliver you to him

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Vito boasts of making himself a saint and of ruling at Aclazotz's side with Vona.
timeline.quote: Together, Vona and I will rule at our master's side
